narrative: The rotation picture shows Technology and Energy running hot and technically extended, while Financials and Health Care sit at oversold extremes with mean-reversion potential. Complacency in options markets suggests the current regime favours trimming momentum and rotating into laggards with improving macro sensitivity. The 3–6 month projected weights reflect a broadening of market leadership away from concentrated growth exposures.
